description:
Launched in September 2025 as part of our 80th year celebrations, the Allroad is a sleek road and gravel hybrid. Designed for high performance across gravel trails and fast roads, the Allroads’ lugless construction offers a clean, contemporary aesthetic combined with lightweight agility. Engineered to excel on varied terrain, the frame offers responsive handling and unmatched versatility with every ride.

This new model, crafted in our Derby HQ, is made with Reynolds 853 double butted oversized steel tubing, with a tapered Columbus head tube and carbon forks. A lugged bottom bracket is used to enhance strength in this key area. The frame is suitable for tyres of up to 45mm. We supply the bike with 35mm tyres as standard in our packages but will alter to any requirement – from 23mm up to 45mm. As an option you can simply purchase two sets of tyres, or even two sets of wheels. Put on your road slicks or your gravel tyres, its your call.

With disc brakes as standard, the bike is available as frame-only or fully assembled: choose one of our three assembly packages – or we can help you build up the assembly to your own specification.
